about.storyText1: Founded with the belief that quality education should be accessible, interactive, and aligned with modern technology, GEKO is building a new way to learn.
about.storyText2: We help learners grow through thoughtful programs in technology, languages, and core skills, guided by experienced educators.
about.missionIntro: A balanced guide ensuring both educational rigor and global future readiness.
about.missionText: To deliver practical, highly interactive lessons in technology, language, and core sciences. We foster collaborative workspaces that inspire critical reasoning, practical experimentation, and emotional intelligence.
about.visionText: To become the leading platform for foundational excellence, where kids and young adults across the region confidently grow as ethical, digitally proficient global citizens.
about.valuesIntro: The foundational principles behind our daily interactions and curriculum design.

teachers.title: Qualified Teachers
teachers.text: Expert certified educators with specialized training in modern student-led teaching styles.

learning.title: Interactive Learning
learning.text: Gamified environments, real-world sandboxes, and highly engaging hands-on challenges.

technology.title: Modern Tech
technology.text: State-of-the-art labs with robotics, AR learning sets, and robust coding interfaces.

programs.title: Flexible Programs
programs.text: Adaptable scheduling formats matching modern families’ dynamic school and holiday routines.
